verses.text: A Psalm, a Song for the Sabbath day. It is good to give thanks to the LORD And to sing praises to Your name, O Most High;
verses.textZh: （安息日的詩歌。）稱謝耶和華！歌頌你至高者的名！

verses.text: To declare Your lovingkindness in the morning And Your faithfulness by night,
verses.textZh: 用十弦的樂器和瑟，用琴彈幽雅的聲音，早晨傳揚你的慈愛；每夜傳揚你的信實。這本為美事。

verses.text: With the ten-stringed lute and with the harp, With resounding music upon the lyre.
For You, O LORD, have made me glad by what You have done, I will sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
verses.textZh: 因你─耶和華藉著你的作為叫我高興，我要因你手的工作歡呼。

verses.text: How great are Your works, O LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你的工作何其大！你的心思極其深！

verses.text: A senseless man has no knowledge, Nor does a stupid man understand this:
verses.textZh: 畜類人不曉得；愚頑人也不明白。

verses.text: That when the wicked sprouted up like grass And all who did iniquity flourished, It [was only] that they might be destroyed forevermore.
verses.textZh: 惡人茂盛如草，一切作孽之人發旺的時候，正是他們要滅亡，直到永遠。

verses.text: But You, O LORD, are on high forever.
verses.textZh: 惟你─耶和華是至高，直到永遠。

verses.text: For, behold, Your enemies, O LORD, For, behold, Your enemies will perish; All who do iniquity will be scattered.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你的仇敵都要滅亡；一切作孽的也要離散。

verses.text: But You have exalted my horn like [that of] the wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.
verses.textZh: 你卻高舉了我的角，如野牛的角；我是被新油膏了的。

verses.text: And my eye has looked [exultantly] upon my foes, My ears hear of the evildoers who rise up against me.
verses.textZh: 我眼睛看見仇敵遭報；我耳朵聽見那些起來攻擊我的惡人受罰。

verses.text: The righteous man will flourish like the palm tree, He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.textZh: 義人要發旺如棕樹，生長如利巴嫩的香柏樹。

verses.text: Planted in the house of the LORD, They will flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.textZh: 他們栽於耶和華的殿中，發旺在我們神的院裡。

verses.text: They will still yield fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and very green,
verses.textZh: 他們年老的時候仍要結果子，要滿了汁漿而常發青，

verses.text: To declare that the LORD is upright; [He is] my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.
verses.textZh: 好顯明耶和華是正直的。他是我的磐石，在他毫無不義。
